test_embed_lookup: test embed.Embed lookup with ARRAY_INDEX or ONE_HOT style across 1D, 2D, and 3D input IDs
test_embed_default_creation: test embed.Embed default creation with vocab_size and embed_dim arguments for both lookup styles
test_embed_no_args: test that embed.Embed raises ValueError when called with no creation arguments supplied
test_embed_inconsistent_args: test that embed.Embed raises ValueError when embedding_matrix is supplied alongside vocab_size or embed_dim
test_embed_dtype_check: test that embed.Embed raises ValueError when called with a float array instead of integer dtype
